facet_contract.facade: The place exterior or dominant building mass is visible.
facet_contract.entrance: An entrance, approach aperture, drop-off, lobby threshold, or immediately connected entrance interior is visible.
facet_contract.side: An oblique side, adjacent plaza, shared complex view, or lateral approach retains place structure.
facet_contract.partial: Only a structural fragment, reflection, close detail, occluded view, or distant contextual view remains; target presence is still source-auditable.

rejections: The pre-freeze audit replaced one non-building development reference, several neighbor/exhibit-only rows, and the Hong Kong Heritage Museum entity whose selected query rows were mostly maps or exhibits. Rejected rows never entered a PB2 model call.
split_integrity: All 12 PB2 entities are absent from the 20-entity PB1 manifest. Development and test entity IDs are disjoint. Test pixels, labels, descriptors, and metrics cannot select a model, fusion rule, threshold objective, or baseline.
claim_boundary: Curated public-image source truth for single-frame place identity. Entity presence and facet labels are human-audited; public access, portal ownership, traversability, temporal causality, navigation, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, and safety are not established.
